notes: - Feature: keep-awake. Why signals came hours apart: Chrome throttles a hidden tab after about 5 minutes and Quotex's socket then dies (live: armed 00:23, "Broker socket closed" 00:29, nothing until the tab was looked at 35 minutes later). The strategies were firing fine: replaying 30S SNIPER on the same 75 live candles gives 7 signals in 37 minutes. While Auto-Trade is on the tab now plays an inaudible 20 Hz tone at -60 dB, which Chrome exempts from throttling (a speaker icon shows on the tab). Settings -> Execution -> "Keep the tab awake while armed", on by default.
